objective: Continue the full CMS-V2 shadcn/ui refactor according to the Luna 6 plan while preserving institutional workflows.
changes: Migrated EvaluationPanel decision selection, status and grade chips, loading and error states, panelist disclosure, and evaluation tables to shared shadcn components and semantic theme tokens.

Replaced browser confirmation and prompt dialogs with accessible AlertDialog and Dialog flows while preserving save-then-submit order, instructor-only unlock reasons, student grade visibility, and the all-panelists-submitted release gate.

Added responsive criterion cards for mobile after visual review found the table compressed editable comment fields; panelist summary rows now wrap names, status, decision, score, and unlock action accessibly.
Corrected BukSU grade-chip presentation to use the canonical grade meaning field and semantic success, warning, destructive, or secondary variants.

verification.lint_and_format: Scoped ESLint passed without warnings; Prettier passed for EvaluationPanel.jsx, EvaluationPanel.test.jsx, the visual audit script, and scratch harness fixtures.
verification.build: Client production build passed with 4,853 modules transformed. Existing Tailwind ambiguous-ease and large-chunk warnings remain.
verification.visual_evidence: Playwright captured 11 screenshots under scratch/qa-evidence/evaluation-panel/: eight role/theme/viewport states and submit/release/unlock dialogs. All were inspected; mobile criteria remain readable, dialogs are centered after Radix animation settling, and checks found no horizontal overflow, Vite overlay, browser page errors, or unexpected HTTP failures. The reusable audit script creates and removes its temporary src harness.

workflow_safety: The visual audit used synthetic in-memory evaluation responses and did not sign in or submit, unlock, release, or otherwise mutate real evaluation records.
